chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It is upon the Imam to pray the Dhuhr prayer in Mina, then he stays overnight there and remains until the sun rises, then he departs to Arafat.

key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: Arafat (the plain of Arafat, central to Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed ritual for the Imam regarding prayer and movement between Mina and Arafat during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the Sunnah of the Imam during Hajj, mandating the consolidation of Dhuhr in Mina before departing for Arafat at sunrise, a practice that underscores the hierarchical structure of ritual leadership in Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the precise temporal sequence of the Hajj rites, linking the prayer in Mina directly to the standing at Arafat, which is the pivotal pillar of the pilgrimage. This detail reflects the scholarly emphasis on following the Prophet's and Imams' exact movements to ensure the validity and perfection of the Hajj ritual.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is upon the Prayer-leader that he Prays Al-Zohr at Mina, then he sleeps over till the sun emerges, then he goes out to Arafaat’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
An Imam must perform Salat (prayer) of al-Zuhr in Mina 5 , stay the night there till the morning until sunrise; then leave for ‘Arafat . ‘“
